split.group: leave one company out; select on training companies, report every held-out prediction
split.test: one frozen configuration, one run; old baselines archived

metrics.oracle: min(5, unique gold pages retrieved)/gold pages
metrics.lines: V3 normalized proxy plus V5.1-style punctuation-preserving, date/section-filtered source proxy

phase1.safety: Fallback F0 unless a metric is parsed; period from source text, no hard year filters; keep candidates intact.

variants: Q4 Q3 plus selected Phase 1 rank
phase2.selection: pool coverage and Recall@5 with fixed phase-1 ranking; no additional query weights

phase3.trigger: If single full-calibration and OOF policy both fail >=.70 quality target, do structure smoke on first six lexicographic eligible Calibration document IDs; then build if at least one independently bound header and >=10 auditable financial rows across smoke docs.
phase3.scope: same 83 PDFs and zero-based page IDs; paragraphs on statement pages and conservative rows/blocks; keep legacy evidence elsewhere/alongside as described; no gold-derived page selection

phase4.gate: Only if still below 0.70 after phase 3, at least 8 Calibration company groups, and a fixed recipe shows complementarity versus raw BGE on >=3 company groups.

selection.stability: quality stop only if full-calibration best and crossfitted policy both >=0.70, no relevant metric drop >.03 and corrected line coverage not worse by >.03 vs corresponding baseline.
selection.deployment: warm and cold mean <= 1.25x same-hardware rerun of S3, show Pareto and cold startup separately.
